membership.title: My membership plan
membership.info: See the plan you hold and buy another. A plan activates when its receipt is paid, not when you choose it.
membership.revertedNotice: You are on the free plan because a fee went unpaid. Paying it puts you back on "{plan}".
membership.noPlans: There are no plans available to buy.
membership.quoteUnavailable: This plan cannot be bought right now.
membership.proratedExplain: This first charge covers {monthsCharged} of {monthsInPeriod} months, up to {periodEnd}. That is why it is less than the plan price ({fullPrice}).
membership.proratedNextCharge: When the next period starts, the full {fullPrice} fee is issued.
membership.notGrantedUntilPaid: The plan activates once the receipt is paid. Until then you keep your current plan and its access.
membership.purchaseRaised: Receipt raised. You can pay it now.
membership.awaitingPaymentExplain: Receipt {receipt}, due {dueDate}. If it is not paid by then it is voided and you are charged nothing. Buying another plan replaces this one.
membership.noOnlinePayment: No online payment is switched on. Pay the receipt however the club asks.
